name: GRL workshop ruleset - build only
description: Same as grl.ruleset.json, but downgrades the planted errors to warnings so that the current .app can be produced. Not for validation.

rules.justification: Workshop sample uses range 50100-50119 (PTE range) instead of a range allocated by Microsoft. Real AppSource apps must use their allocated range.
No Application Insights resource for a workshop sample.
Namespaces are out of scope for the workshop.
Build-only: lets the compiler emit the .app. The finding is still reported.
